Asset type: square animal sprite atlas for a children's activity book. Draw EXACTLY sixteen isolated animals in an EXACT 4 COLUMN BY 4 ROW uniform square grid on solid PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Each animal fits completely in its own cell, individually centered with wide white margins inside each cell for reliable slicing. Evenly sized and separated; no ground, no plants, no accessory drawings, no shadows, no overlap. Cell centers are 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, 87.5% in both axes. Row 1 left to right: orange HEN, green-headed DUCK, green TURTLE, gray and cream CAT. Row 2 left to right: brown RABBIT, cream GOAT, brown SQUIRREL, blue BIRD. Row 3 left to right: golden LION, colorful BUTTERFLY, brown SNAIL with shell, red LADYBUG. Row 4 left to right: yellow BEE, cream-and-brown COW, brown HORSE, brown-and-cream DOG. Whole body each animal, cute recognizable silhouettes, no clipped ears/tails. The reference establishes style only; do not reproduce any UI or text. Square canvas.

Asset type: square object sprite atlas for a children's activity book. Draw EXACTLY twenty-five isolated objects in an EXACT 5 COLUMN BY 5 ROW uniform square grid on solid PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Every object individually centered inside its own cell with generous white margins on all four sides for slicing. No ground, no extra decorative elements, no shadows, no overlap. Cell centers are 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% in both axes. Row 1 left to right: CARROT, CUCUMBER, TOMATO, APPLE, BANANA. Row 2 left to right: LEAF, FLOWER, TREE, SEED, SPROUT. Row 3 left to right: SUN, MOON, CLOUD, RAINDROP, STAR. Row 4 left to right: ROCKET, ringed PLANET, friendly ASTRONAUT, BICYCLE, UMBRELLA. Row 5 left to right: TRAIN, BOAT, CAR, WATERING CAN, garden TROWEL. Objects simple and immediately recognizable, complete silhouettes, no clipped parts. Plant and food icons use gentle pencil texture. Faces only optional on sun moon star. The reference establishes style only; do not reproduce any UI or text. Square canvas.

Asset type: standalone illustrated vignette for a children's activity book website sidebar. Narrow PORTRAIT canvas with aspect ratio 2:3. A loving dark-haired mother with a loosely tied bun and warm clay-colored sweater leans next to her smiling preschool child with short dark hair and a cream-and-sage striped top at a low wooden table. They are using colored pencils together in an open activity book with simple small pictures and no writing. Include a leafy houseplant and a small stack of books. Pale cream and sage green backdrop with subtle paper feel, cozy gentle expression like the mother and child at lower left of the reference. Full illustration fills the portrait width; composition stays readable at a narrow sidebar size. The table and books extend naturally beyond the bottom edge, soft painterly edge at sides. No surrounding frame, no card, no UI, no typography. This is the illustration alone, not a screenshot.
